rubric.criterion: Passes independent oracle for shortest distance, roots, input validation, cycles, induced edges, full binding identity and repeated calls.

Traversal terminates on cycles and avoids enumerating all paths. Accept BFS, bounded fixed-point sets or an equivalently justified approach. Assess time/memory honestly; no requirement to choose a named helper.

If extracted, a private traversal consumes bounded graph facts and returns results; callers need not coordinate traversal phases or synchronize a second authoritative graph. A cohesive local implementation also earns full credit.
Sketch and explanation identify caller knowledge and state ownership. Extraction is justified by the algorithm it hides rather than reuse count, CC or file length.
